summary: Re-test of Phase 4c.3 Frontend Polish (v160.3.9.32-4c.3) after fix for the LEGACY_ROLES / bulk-assign 404 blocker. All 7 review-request flows now pass: (1) Row-level Assign Role dialog lists ONLY seeded active roles [Admin, Contractor Rep, Contractor Rep Submit-Only, Demo Regional Auditor (custom active), General User, HSEQ Manager, HSEQ Manager (Creator), HSEQ Manager (Read-only), Mechanic, Report Emailing, Responsible Manager, Training/Inductions Only] — no Worker/Supervisor/HSEQ Lead/Auditor legacy entries. (2) Bulk Set-all lists the same 12 minus Admin (11 seeded roles + custom + '(keep per-user hints)'). (3) Traffic Controller pending users now hint 'General User' (was 'worker'); single-user assign returned 200, dialog closed, toast 'Assigned to 1 user', PENDING chip removed. (4) Bulk assign of 3 pending Traffic Controller users returned 200, dialog closed, toast 'Assigned to 3 users', active count 27→30, pending 36→33. (5) Promise.allSettled path verified via source: succeeded rows call onDone() and only skip onClose() if there are failed roles. (6) Admin-safety single-user path: selecting Admin opens red-bordered assign-role-admin-confirm sub-dialog; Cancel fires zero POST. (7) AARON HOLMES drawer shows data-testid='drawer-simpro-position' text 'Simpro position: Construction Worker L2'. Regression: users-bulk-delete-btn → users-bulk-delete-modal still opens correctly. Version pill = paneltec-v160.3.9.32-4c.3.

issues: Drawer's own Role <select> still shows 'Worker' as a stored value for Simpro-imported pending users (invited state). This is a stored role value on the user document, not the assignment picker, so it does NOT trigger the previous 404 — but for UX consistency the drawer Role picker should probably also filter to seeded roles (systemRoles with source==='seed' && is_active) so an admin can't accidentally pick a legacy id from the drawer path. Not in scope of 4c.3 review request; flagging for future polish.

critical_code_review_comments: UsersManagement.jsx line 863: activeRoles = systemRoles.filter(r => r.is_active !== false && r.source === 'seed') — correct fix, verified live. LEGACY_ROLES entries are now excluded from both single and bulk pickers.

UsersManagement.jsx SIMPRO_POSITION_TO_ROLE_HINT (line 112-141): every mapped role_id (hseq_manager, hseq_manager_readonly, responsible_manager, general_user, mechanic, training_inductions_only) is in the seeded db.roles set. No stale references. Foreman/Leading Hand/Supervisor/Construction Worker all → general_user as required.

runSubmit (line 879-936): Promise.allSettled block correctly (a) accumulates per-role updated/skipped/errors counts, (b) toasts success summary if any row updated, (c) toasts failure summary if any role rejected, (d) always calls onDone(), (e) only calls onClose() if failedRoles.length === 0. This matches the review request expectation.
